get.description: Your repositories with a finding that cites this CVE (open or fixed), one page at a time.
Anyone can read them (they explain due dates); an administrator changes them.
Most urgent first. The ENISA draft is only built for the events on the page.
Analyzed assets that can still be marked as products, filtered by name.

post.description: Branches whose PRs are reviewed; an empty list means the repository's default branch.
Reviews (or reviews again) a pull request's head commit now, whether the repository is watched or not.
Sets the branch every platform scan of this repository reads; null goes back to the default branch.

get.description: What secret detection applies to every repository scan; only admins see (and change) the patterns.

post.description: Replaces the settings; takes effect from the next scan. A reason is required and kept in the history.

get.description: A repository's own secret detection entries (empty: it uses the defaults as they are).

post.description: Replaces a repository's own entries; they add to the defaults from its next scan. A reason is required.

get.description: Gitleaks' default rules (what can be turned off), with the Trivy rule that is turned off with each, if any.

AssetSecretConfig.title: AssetSecretConfig
AssetSecretConfig.description: A repository's own entries, added to the defaults (`defaults` counts them) in its scans.

SecretAllowlist.title: SecretAllowlist
SecretAllowlist.description: Regexes are matched against the detected secret; paths are globs relative to the repository root.

SlaDays.title: SlaDays
